cc_updates.body: Auto mode is now available on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry for Opus 4.7 and Opus 4.8. Opt in by setting `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE=1`

Plugins in `.claude/skills` directories are now automatically loaded, no marketplace required. Added `claude plugin init <name>` to scaffold a new plugin. Added autocomplete for `/plugin` arguments. `claude agents`: the `agent` field in `settings.json` is now honored for dispatched sessions. EnterWorktree can now switch between Claude-managed worktrees mid-session. Fixed unprocessable images attached via paste crashing requests. Fixed sandbox network permission prompts in auto mode. Fixed background agent worktrees being orphaned after retention sweep. Fixed background sessions not telling the model correct date after sleep/wake. Fixed copy-on-select in `claude agents` not reaching system clipboard in tmux. Fixed `--resume` not reporting background subagents. Fixed `--worktree` returning to canonical repo root. Fixed `/model` picker showing incorrect hints. Fixed terminal freezing after managed-settings dialog. Improved long conversation performance.
